meta.name: init-deep
meta.description: Initializes a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project. Use when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理项目的代码结构、运行命令与协作规则,生成 AI 可读的指南。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你的项目需要向 AI 助手说明清楚自己的结构、命令和约定。
copy.tagline_en: Turn your repo's structure, commands, and conventions into an AI-readable guide.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your repo needs to explain its structure, commands, and conventions to AI agents.

howto.what: 为项目生成一份分层的 AGENTS.md 文档库:在根目录以及代码复杂度较高的子目录里分别建立 AGENTS.md,记录项目结构、命令和约定,供 agent 阅读。
howto.when: 当仓库需要把结构、命令和约定写成 AGENTS.md 给 agent 用时触发,或当你用 /init-deep 等命令提出该要求时。

say.text: 把 AGENTS.md 限制在两层目录深度以内。
say.note: 对应 --max-depth=2 参数,默认限制是三层。

howto.what_en: Generates a hierarchical AGENTS.md knowledge base for a project: creates AGENTS.md files at the root and in subdirectories that score high on complexity, documenting structure, commands, and conventions for agents.
howto.when_en: Triggers when a repo needs its structure, commands, and conventions documented for agents, or when the user requests it, e.g. via the /init-deep command.

say_en.text: Run /init-deep for this project to generate AGENTS.md files for the root and subdirectories.
say_en.note: It maps the project first, then writes the docs.

say_en.text: Regenerate all AGENTS.md from scratch with --create-new, reading existing files first.
say_en.note: Existing content is used as reference, then all files are removed and rebuilt.

say_en.text: Restrict AGENTS.md generation to two directory levels.
say_en.note: This uses --max-depth=2; the default depth limit is three.
